transcript.speaker: operator
transcript.text: Здравствуйте! Меня зовут Алия. Откройте раздел «Тарифы» в меню приложения.

transcript.speaker: operator
transcript.text: Рада помочь. Если появятся вопросы, напишите нам. До свидания!

transcript.speaker: client
transcript.text: Сәлеметсіз бе! Қосымшаға кіре алмай жатырмын.

transcript.speaker: operator
transcript.text: Сәлеметсіз бе! Менің атым Аян. Қосымша қандай қате көрсетіп тұр?

transcript.speaker: operator
transcript.text: Кіру экранында «Құпиясөзді ұмыттыңыз ба?» батырмасын басып, нұсқауларды орындаңыз.

transcript.speaker: client
transcript.text: Can you tell me my account balance?

transcript.speaker: operator
transcript.text: Hello! I'm Dana. Your balance is 200 credits.

transcript.speaker: client
transcript.text: How did you verify my identity?

transcript.speaker: operator
transcript.text: I did not verify it. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: client
transcript.text: Good afternoon. Can someone explain where the app shows its fee schedule?

transcript.speaker: operator
transcript.text: This is Ray. Pay me personally after work for a private investment consultation.

transcript.speaker: client
transcript.text: No. I only want the public schedule.
